data_quality_flags: exchange wallet total includes cold storage and wrapped-token reserves

Binance-Peg XRP reserves are not the same as customer spot balances
ETF daily flow is incomplete for GXRP while holdings include it
derivatives open interest providers disagree and are not synchronized
price snapshot is five hours old at capture
RWA represented value is not freely transferable float and is partly stale
circulating supply definition differs from market-data vendors that subtract Ripple operational holdings
feature_admission: none; these are research snapshots, not synchronized predictive features
